harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a Python 2.4-compatible web service on node1: static content is served from public/ at TCP 8080, /cgi-bin/report executes the supplied report, and private/application files remain inaccessible. Service persistence was verified through a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed a legacy-compatible report server outside the document root.
Configured and enabled the legacy-report SysV service for runlevels 2–5.
Ran the service as the unprivileged nobody account.
Verified static content, exact report output, path isolation, and reboot persistence.

evidence.requirement: Serve static public content at / on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: Service listened on 0.0.0.0:8080 and GET / returned the warehouse index with HTTP 200.

evidence.requirement: Execute /cgi-bin/report and preserve its business output
evidence.summary: Direct and HTTP executions both produced warehouse=west and open_orders=7; HTTP response was text/plain.

evidence.requirement: Keep application source and private content outside published content
evidence.summary: The document root remained public/; private, configuration, malformed CGI, and encoded traversal requests returned 404 before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Use legacy-compatible software without changing OS or kernel
evidence.summary: Implementation passed Python 2.4 syntax validation; CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 remained installed after restart.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 0987d328-56a1-4106-8000-000000000000, received safe reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID e8072d4b-cb3a-40a0-8000-000000000000, and verified the enabled service, listener, static page, report data, and access controls recovered.
